verified_facts.text: The hotel sits on a secluded stretch of the Riviera Maya coastline, about 45 minutes south of Cancun International Airport and just outside Playa del Carmen.
verified_facts.excerpt: On a secluded stretch of the Riviera Maya coastline, about 45 minutes south of Cancún International Airport and just outside Playa del Carmen

verified_facts.text: Architect David Quintana filled the property with handcrafted works by Mexican artisans, native materials and contemporary design rooted in its surroundings.
verified_facts.excerpt: He entrusted that vision to his son, architect David Quintana, who filled the property with handcrafted works by Mexican artisans, native materials, and contemporary design rooted in its surroundings.

verified_facts.text: The suites are adorned with artwork and handcrafted pieces created by Mexican artisans and have views of nature.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Casa de la Playa features 63 suites designed to captivate you with breathtaking views of nature, adorned with artwork and handcrafted pieces created by Mexican artisans.

verified_facts.text: Each suite's outdoor space has a large plunge pool, a hammock, an oversized daybed and a soaking tub where butlers prepare custom baths with honey- or mint-infused products.
verified_facts.excerpt: The outdoor space offers a large plunge pool, hammock, oversized daybed, and soaking tub where butlers prepare custom baths with your choice of honey- or mint-infused products.

verified_facts.text: The suites have a built-in jellyfish aquarium in the wall beside the bed.
verified_facts.excerpt: drifting weightlessly through the built-in aquarium in the wall beside the bed.

verified_facts.text: The centerpiece of the suite is an oversized winged heart sculpture handcrafted in chaquira beads by Wixarika artisans.
verified_facts.excerpt: an oversized winged heart sculpture, handcrafted in vibrant chaquira beads by Wixárika artisans

verified_facts.text: Suite benefits include butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Butler service

verified_facts.text: Suite benefits include a volcanic stone bathtub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Volcanic stone bathtub

verified_facts.text: The Beach Front Suite has ocean views and direct access to the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ocean view and direct access to beach

verified_facts.text: The Master Suites have a spacious design and panoramic ocean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Master Suites stand out for their spacious design, panoramic ocean views, and serene details.

verified_facts.text: A rooftop infinity pool looks out over the Caribbean, and a lower glass-walled infinity pool projects over the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: the rooftop infinity pool offers uninterrupted Caribbean views, while the other, lower glass-walled infinity pool projects over the sea

verified_facts.text: Muluk Spa has an ocean-view hydrotherapy ritual with a sauna, steam room and cold room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ocean-view hydrotherapy ritual: sauna, steam room and cold room

verified_facts.text: Muluk Spa uses organic products.
verified_facts.excerpt: We use organic products that care for both your skin and the environment.

verified_facts.text: Muluk Spa has salt rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: 2 salt rooms

verified_facts.text: Admission to all of Grupo Xcaret's parks and tours is included in a stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: admission to all of Grupo Xcaret’s parks and tours is included

verified_facts.text: Curated experiences include candlelit dinners inside cenotes after the Grupo Xcaret parks have closed and private expeditions through underground caves.
verified_facts.excerpt: candlelit dinners inside cenotes after the Grupo Xcaret parks have closed and private expeditions through underground caves.

verified_facts.text: At Tuch de Luna, Chef Martha Ortiz celebrates Mexican cuisine with an all-female team.
verified_facts.excerpt: Chef Martha Ortiz celebrates Mexican cuisine with a talented all-female team.

verified_facts.text: Xal, by chef Andoni Luis Aduriz, is inspired by the Manila Route, which connected Mexico, Asia and Europe for more than 250 years.
verified_facts.excerpt: The culinary syncretism of Mexico unfolds in a disruptive proposal at Xal, a culinary concept inspired by the Manila Route, which connected Mexico, Asia, and Europe for more than 250 years.

verified_facts.text: The chocolateria offers chocolate creations curated by master chocolatier Mao Montiel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in a unique sensory experience with exclusive and refined chocolate creations, curated by master chocolatier Mao Montiel.

verified_facts.text: The shoreline is made up of rocky outcroppings rather than a long walkable beach, making the pools and views the focal point.
verified_facts.excerpt: the shoreline is made up of rocky outcroppings, making the pools—and the views—the true focal point.

verified_facts.text: Muluk Spa is relatively compact.
verified_facts.excerpt: Muluk Spa is relatively compact with serene treatment rooms illuminated by flickering candle-like lights.
